Amorphous Solid:-

• Conversion from a liquid to a crystalline state.

questions.q: The average of three numbers is 15. The average of the second and the third number is 12.5. What is the first number?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Average of all 3 numbers = 15

Deviation of the 2nd and 3rd numbers from the total average = 12.5 − 15 = −2.5

Total deviation for these 2 numbers = −2.5 × 2 = −5

To balance the average, the 1st number must be +5 more than the total average.

First number = 15 + 5 = 20

∴ The correct answer is 20.

Alternate Method

Given:

Average of three numbers = 15

Average of the second and third number = 12.5

Formula Used:

Sum of given numbers = Average × Number of terms



Calculations:

⇒ Let the three numbers be a, b, and c.

⇒ Average of a, b, and c = (a + b + c) ÷ 3 = 15

⇒ Sum of all three numbers (a + b + c) = 15 × 3 = 45

⇒ Average of b and c = (b + c) ÷ 2 = 12.5

⇒ Sum of the second and third number (b + c) = 12.5 × 2 = 25

⇒ Substitute the value of (b + c) in the first equation:

⇒ a + 25 = 45

⇒ a = 45 − 25

⇒ a = 20

∴ The correct answer is 20.

Additional Information

Combined Average

If the average of n₁ items is A₁ and n₂ items is A₂, then the combined average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Weighted Average

Used when different items have varying levels of importance or frequencies. Formula: Weighted Average = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + ...) ÷ (w₁ + w₂ + ...).

Average of Arithmetic Progression

For a set of numbers that form an Arithmetic Progression (equal difference between consecutive terms), the average is simply the middle term, calculated as (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2.

questions.q: X, Y and Z can complete a piece of work in 46 days, 92 days and 23 days, respectively. X started the work. Y joined him after 7 days. If Z joined them after 8 days from the beginning, then for how many days did Y work?
questions.solution:
Given data:

Days in which X can complete the work = 46 days

Days in which Y can complete the work = 92 days

Days in which Z can complete the work = 23 days

Days after which Y joined = 7 days

Days after which Z joined = 8 days

Formula used:

Efficiency = Total work / Time taken to complete work individually

Calculation:

LCM of 23, 46, 92 = 92

Assuming that the total work is 92 units.

Efficiency of x-

⇒ 92over 46 = 2 units of work/day

Efficiency of y-

⇒ 92over 92 = 1 unit of work/day

Efficiency of z-

⇒ 92over 23 = 4 units of work/day

Work done in 7 days by X working alone = 2 units × 7 = 14 units

Work done by X and Y on 8th day = (2 + 1) × 1 = 3 units

Total work done until 8th day = 14 + 3 = 17 units

Remaining work = 92 - 17 = 75 units

Work done by X , Y and Z in one day = 2 + 1 + 4 = 7 units

Total time taken = 75over 7 days

Total days worked by Y = 75over 7 + 1 = 82over 7 = 115over 7 days.

∴ Y worked for 115over 7 days.

Shortcut TrickLet the total work be 92 units.

x = 46 days = 2 units/day

y = 92 days = 1 unit/day

z = 23 days = 4 units/day

Let the work be completed in Q days.

According to the question,

2Q + 1 × (Q - 7) + 4 × (Q - 8) = 92

⇒ 7Q - 39 = 92

⇒ Q = 131/7

⇒ Q - 7 = 131/7 - 7 (Subtracting 7 from both sides)

⇒ Q - 7 = 11(5)/(7)

∴ Y worked for 11(5)/(7) days.
